title: Guest Experience App
description: An invite-only mobile app for the guests of a multi-day event, built first for an Indian wedding. Guests get schedule cards and the ceremony program, live announcements with push, chat, travel and arrival tracking, find-my-seat, a disposable-camera film reel with a shared gallery, and challenges, trivia and leaderboards, in one of four watercolour themes. Hosts manage the event from the app and a CLI. Flutter on iOS, Android and the web, over a Go API on Cloud Run with Firestore, Cloud Storage and Firebase push. It has run end to end on a sample wedding with invented guests; it has not yet been used at a real event.
